title: Tool Search Lifecycle
brief: A flat-tech infographic showing the Claude Tool Search lifecycle. Horizontal flow with arrows: 1) User query; 2) Claude decides to search and emits server_tool_use with tool_search_tool_regex + pattern; 3) API runs search and returns tool_references; 4) API expands referenced tools into full definitions; 5) Claude emits normal tool_use; 6) Client executes tool and returns tool_result. Include concise Chinese/English labels: server_tool_use, tool_reference, tool_use, tool_result. Clean, professional, soft colors.
